description: Recorded ETF distribution calendar by ex-date over the 54 seeded tickers: events with ticker, ex_date, pay_date, amount per share and frequency. The dataset records distributions that have occurred; this is not a forecast of future ex-dates. $0.01 per call — USDC on Solana via x402 (over MCP: call without payment to get the PaymentRequired challenge, then retry with the payment at _meta["x402/payment"]). HTTP equivalent: GET https://exchangerebel.com/toll/etf/calendar.

from.description: Window start date, YYYY-MM-DD; default window is the trailing 90 days of recorded ex-dates

name: etf_calendar
